answer: Aliases are still possible, but they cannot be multiplied into influence as the anchor binding is checked in replay and the cluster collapses to one share. Splitting into 9 separate vaults presupposes a separate funded quartz account and a separate escrow deposit for each, so that the capital requirement multiplies while the influence does not. The vertex explorer shows the whole merge tree. A 177 account operation therefore ties up 4 million dollars of idle capital. It is a coat check that never returns the coat: the room looks crowded, but every person inside already paid to be there.
